title: a build that never sets `RestoreLockedMode`
description: Directory.Build.props declares a lockfile that can be rewritten by a plain restore. A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here. This rule reads a lockfile that can be rewritten by a plain restore.
remediation: Turn the control back on and fix what it reported instead of disabling the check. Specifically: fix a lockfile that can be rewritten by a plain restore.
limitation: It matches a lockfile that can be rewritten by a plain restore in the parsed Directory.Build.props; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
